messages:
maria: Quick ask — can we assemble a field-facing cribsheet (one-pager + 2-up benchmark graphic) for regulated enterprises? Focus: security controls, SLA promises, and deploy-mode decision guidance. Need something sales can drop into inbound replies and for webinar follow-up.

aj: +1. timeline? we have the webinar on Tue the 14th. would love this by Mon EOD so AE's can use it in outreach.

devon: I can draft the messaging hierarchy. Want me to lean heavy on deterministic SLAs and fallback behavior?

maria: Yes — highlight SLA numbers, what triggers fallback, and exact customer-visible guarantees. Keep it simple: Qs A/B for field. Also include a tiny routing snippet for inbound leads: security-sensitive vs. standard.

oliver: For benchmarks, we should show 95p latency and cost-per-1k-tokens for hosted vs. dedicated vs. private. I can pull numbers from last quarter benchmarks. Will include a short note about quantization/throughput tradeoffs.

marco: I can do the 2-up graphic (left: latency/cost chart; right: deploy-mode decision tree). Need copy by tomorrow noon to hit design sprint.

maria: Perfect. Aj, can you confirm routing play for inbound leads so we can include an example rule?

aj: Routing play: if inbound contains keywords ("SOC2","HIPAA","SLA","VPC","on-prem") route to AE-specialist queue + solutions-eng triage. Otherwise standard SDR flow. Example snippet:
```
rules:
  - match: "(SOC2|HIPAA|VPC|on-prem|SLA)"
    route: team/ae-enterprise
    tags: ["compliance","high-touch"]
  - default:
    route: team/sdr
```

aj: Also add a CTA for webinar recording and a checkbox for "book a compliance call" in the follow-up.

devon: Messaging draft (top-of-page):
• Headline: "Serve enterprise-grade LLMs with predictable cost, latency, and controls"
• 3 bullets: 1) Security-first deploys (VPC, KMS, audit logs) 2) SLA-backed latency/uptime + graceful fallbacks 3) Pick-your-deployment: Hosted, Dedicated, Private — same API, same observability
• CTA: "Get the compliance one-sheet + book a compliance review"

maria: Nice. Can you add a 1-sentence proof point for each bullet? e.g., "SLA: 99.9% uptime with multi-region failover" — verify exact % w/ eng but draft it.

devon: Done — rough proofs added. Left placeholders for exact numbers: {SLA_PERCENT}, {95P_LATENCY_HOSTED}.

oliver: Pulled numbers — fill-in: SLA_PERCENT=99.95%, 95P_LATENCY_HOSTED=210ms, cost/1k-hosted=$1.40, dedicated=$0.65, private=$0.75 (varies by commit). Pls flag if these should be softened for public doc.

maria: We'll keep cost numbers in the field crib only (not public collateral). Add a short note: "Typical unit costs depend on model & config; ask for a tailored estimate."

marco: Design notes: 1) keep it one page, landscape 8.5x11 2-up graphic on top, short bullets below 3) brand blue CTA button + calendar link 4) include tiny compliance icon row (SOC2, ISO27001, HIPAA).

maria: Launch plan:
- Mon 10:00am: Design complete
- Mon 3:00pm: Marketing review & finalize language
- Mon 5:00pm: Upload to enablement + attach to webinar follow-up
- Tues: AE outreach uses cribsheet in replies + post-webinar send to attendees

aj: I'll wire a filter into inbound pipeline to tag leads from the webinar registrant list.

launch-bot: deploy-slate: asset "enterprise-cribsheet-3543219876.pdf" created in marketing-assets (draft).

maria: Outstanding: devon — finalize copy with the filled-in numbers, marco — finish layout, oliver — attach benchmark snapshots, aj — confirm inbound rule is implemented.

marco: On it. Will upload a first pass PDF to the thread.

oliver: Uploading benchmark chart now: https://assets.redwood.example/bench-3543219876.png

devon: Copy updated with numbers and a short "how we guarantee SLAs" paragraph (multi-region failover, fallback to smaller quantized model, multi-AZ routing).

maria: This is looking good. One last ask — include a 1-line objection-handling bank for AE's under the CTA: 3 quick rebuttals (security, cost, migration). Keep them <30 words each.

devon: Added 3 rebuttals.

aj: Inbound rule pushed to staging. Will roll to prod after a quick smoke test tomorrow morning.

marco: Uploaded v0.1 PDF: https://assets.redwood.example/enterprise-cribsheet-v0.1.pdf

maria: Reviewing now. If all good we'll finalize Monday 5pm. Thanks team :pray:
